account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Transcription resource.

api_version.description: The API version used to create the transcription.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was last updated specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

duration.description: The duration of the transcribed audio in seconds.

price.description: The charge for the transcript in the currency associated with the account. This value is populated after the transcript is complete so it may not be available immediately.

price_unit.description: The currency in which `price` is measured, in [ISO 4127](https://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/currency_codes.htm) format (e.g. `usd`, `eur`, `jpy`).

recording_sid.description: The SID of the [Recording](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/recording) from which the transcription was created.

sid.description: The unique string that that we created to identify the Transcription resource.

transcription_text.description: The text content of the transcription.

type.description: The transcription type. Can only be: `fast`.

uri.description: The URI of the resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.
